title: Effect of Sintering Temperature on the Microstructure and Integrated Properties of MgAlTiVFeCo Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy

recollection.mechanism: phase transformation and grain growth during sintering
recollection.results: changes in mechanical properties and density correlated with sintering temperature

score.note: The recollection only gives generic sintering-temperature effects. It omits SPS at the optimal 1000 °C, the dense microstructure and specific oxide barrier phases, the passive-film/diffusion-controlled oxidation mechanism, and all reported numerical results.
